items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: I don't know. It doesn't seem to fit exactly, does it? To fit who? It doesn't seem to fit into the categories, you know, where you could say that Dizzy was sounding like Roy Eldridge and ...... No, it doesn't sound like anybody.

ctx.x: Well that was one thing that I remember Edgar Battle and Eddie Burham they were with a circus.(at one time weren't they?)?
Yes and Roy Eldridge I believe was.......
I'm not (issuing them out?) purely of playing for the circus show, it's the shows outside.
